544:t_2:257.en:
$$宗介$$
「What is the original world? By that logic, every world since the $$大時空震動$$ would be wrong.」

544:t_2:258.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Then suppose this world is wrong. What do you think should be done with it?」

544:t_2:259.en:
$$宗介$$
「Nothing needs to be done. Leave it alone. You could not remake the world unless you were a god...」

544:t_2:261.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's right. If you become a god, you can put this world right.」

544:t_2:262.en:
$$レナード$$
「You can restore this distorted world to its original history.」

544:t_2:264.en:
$$宗介$$
「Wouldn't restoring your 'original history' deny all of us living in the current one? That is what I cannot accept.」

544:t_2:265.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then what would you do? Would you gather the will of everyone in the world, as you did when you broke the $$時の牢獄$$?」

544:t_2:267.en:
$$レナード$$
「That is what's absurd. Asking each person who doesn't understand this world's meaning for permission is pointless.」

544:t_2:268.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then are you saying you would remake the world by your will alone?」

544:t_2:269.en:
$$レナード$$
「Let me ask you instead. What would you do if $$千鳥かなめ$$ died?」

544:t_2:271.en:
$$レナード$$
「If that were the result of a distorted world, wouldn't you think of remaking the world?」

544:t_2:273.en:
$$レナード$$
「You can't answer... Of course you can't.」

544:t_2:274.en:
$$レナード$$
「If I were in your position, I wouldn't accept it. Rules, unwritten laws... such platitudes don't work in the realm of emotion.」

544:t_2:275.en:
$$レナード$$
「Don't you people see things too simply?」

544:t_2:276.en:
$$レナード$$
「Good and evil, likes and dislikes, enemies and allies... Even you don't believe in such black-and-white divisions.」

544:t_2:277.en:
$$宗介$$
「What are you trying to say?」

544:t_2:278.en:
$$レナード$$
「Who knows? I just thought that perhaps we might not need to fight at all.」

544:t_2:280.en:
$$レナード$$
「I wasn't proposing peace. Besides, whatever I explain, your answer will be no anyway, won't it?」

544:t_2:281.en:
$$レナード$$
「I've known that for a long time, so I never tried to win you over.」

544:t_2:283.en:
$$レナード$$
「Your stubbornness is a real headache. ...But $$カリーニン$$ was different.」

544:t_2:286.en:
$$宗介$$
「The Major would never defect over your delusions.」

544:t_2:287.en:
$$レナード$$
「What do you know about him?」

544:t_2:289.en:
$$レナード$$
「He sensed distortion in this world... You could even say he hated it.」

544:t_2:290.en:
$$レナード$$
「To show him the power to correct it, I used that at $$第２新東京市$$.」

544:t_2:292.en:
$$レナード$$
「That's right. It has meaning beyond its use as a weapon.」

544:t_2:293.en:
$$レナード$$
「And he was convinced that there was a way to correct the mistake, and that I had that power.」

544:t_2:294.en:
$$レナード$$
「To be precise, he didn't side with $$アマルガム$$. He sided with me.」

544:t_2:296.en:
$$宗介$$
(But... the Major did speak of this world's unnaturalness... citing the existence of ASes...)

544:t_2:297.en:
$$レナード$$
「I'll tell you this: $$テレサ$$ has some idea of my purpose.」

544:t_2:298.en:
$$レナード$$
「And yet she is trying to stop me without explaining anything to you. Do you know why?」

544:t_2:299.en:
$$宗介$$
「...Are you saying some in $$ミスリル$$... no, even $c, would agree with you?」

544:t_2:300.en:
$$レナード$$
「Exactly. That's why $$テレサ$$ won't explain everything.」

544:t_2:301.en:
$$レナード$$
「She thinks we should accept the past and let history continue. It's positive and admirable, a perfect excuse for self-righteousness.」

544:t_2:302.en:
$$レナード$$
「She probably wants revenge on $$アマルガム$$ too. She probably objects to controlling the world.」

544:t_2:303.en:
$$レナード$$
「But her biggest motive is defying me. She thinks she can only prove her own power by rejecting what I do.」

544:t_2:304.en:
$$宗介$$
「She is not such a selfish person.」

544:t_2:305.en:
$$レナード$$
「That sibling quarrel will end soon too.」

544:t_2:307.en:
$$レナード$$
「Construction of the new $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ is in its final stage.」

544:t_2:308.en:
$$レナード$$
「Its scale dwarfs every $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ built before it.」

544:t_2:309.en:
$$レナード$$
「I will combine its power with the $$時空震動弾$$ to interfere with the past.」

544:t_2:310.en:
$$宗介$$
「So that is your final plan.」

544:t_2:311.en:
$$レナード$$
「An ordinary $$ウィスパード$$ won't do as the catalyst. We need the one imprinted with the greatest power, probably the only suitable person.」

544:t_2:312.en:
$$レナード$$
「It is the person who received the most information from the psychic waves... the Tau waves from the accident here, the Singularity of $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$' rampage...」

544:t_2:315.en:
$$レナード$$
「The one who sent the $$ウィスパード$$ technical information from the future wasn't some unknown person.」

544:t_2:316.en:
$$レナード$$
「It was her. She is supposed to do that from now on.」

544:t_2:318.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is abnormally lucky because she is a living Singularity.」

544:t_2:319.en:
$$レナード$$
「You could say she is not a $$ウィスパード$$, one who is whispered to, but a $$ウィスパリング$$, one who whispers...」

544:t_2:320.en:
$$レナード$$
「She is the one who sent the Black Technology that turned this world upside down into the past.」

544:t_2:321.en:
$$宗介$$
「...She is a decent person. Whatever the logic, she would never gladly send world-distorting technology anywhere.」

544:t_2:322.en:
$$宗介$$
「I do not understand the sequence, but in any case, she would never do that.」

544:t_2:324.en:
$$レナード$$
「Why would a girl so strong and righteous interfere with the past?」

544:t_2:325.en:
$$レナード$$
「What past could she possibly be unable to accept?」

544:t_2:326.en:
$$レナード$$
「Did it happen long ago? Or is it something yet to happen?」

544:t_2:327.en:
$$レナード$$
「Who devised the information she possesses in the first place? Is there another $$ウィスパリング$$ further in the future?」

544:t_2:330.en:
$$宗介$$
「What I do know is that I cannot hand $$千鳥$$ to a man like you.」

544:t_2:331.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even if you get her back, you can't return to your old life.」

544:t_2:334.en:
$$レナード$$
「Even if I let her go, someone else... the Empire, for example, will eventually target her.」

544:t_2:335.en:
$$レナード$$
「As long as she has that ability, there is no safe haven in this distorted world.」
